cond_0096.responsibilities:
Manufacture and package products following SOPs
Use local ERP systems to accurately document manufacturing processes and stay in regular contact with the team to keep records current
Stock area inventories as necessary
Maintain lab cleanliness and comply with cGMP requirements
Perform microtomy, IHC staining, and troubleshooting
Maintain records and keep spreadsheets updated
Escalate any non-conforming products to management and actively participate in the investigation process
Meet productivity standards and work with the team to increase productivity without sacrificing quality and safety
Look for ways to improve and promote quality
Demonstrate accuracy and thoroughness
Manage time and priorities to meet deadlines
Troubleshoot equipment problems and communicate issues promptly
Work on various projects to improve efficiency or compliance
Follow regulatory and standard requirements as applicable to the site, i.e., MDSAP, ISO 13485, IVDR, and compliance with the site Quality Manual
Other duties as assigned or required by the business
cond_0096.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
AA/AS in a biological science or biochemistry field with 1 year of production experience, OR high school diploma/GED and 3 years of lab experience in a related discipline supporting performance of required tasks in a final production role
Good computer skills, including MS Office
Good organizational skills and attention to detail
Good verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to create clear, concise written reports and accurately complete batch records
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge of FDA QSRs and ISO 13485 or other related industry standards
Experience with SAP or other ERP systems
Previous experience in an FDA-regulated biotechnology or pharmaceutical environment
Knowledge of [Product name masked]

cond_0292.intro: Under supervision, the Production Lab Technician - Manufacturing Histology performs laboratory activities in the manufacturing lab including slide manufacturing events and packaging events, and assists in tasks required for block qualification; follows the manufacturing schedule to complete required tasks per standard operating procedures involving basic laboratory techniques, calculations, material measurements, operation of laboratory equipment and record keeping as necessary. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of histology lab work and manufacturing processes.
cond_0292.responsibilities:
The Production Lab Technician will manufacture and package products following SOPs
Use local ERP systems to accurately document manufacturing processes
Stock area inventories as necessary
Maintain lab cleanliness and comply with cGMP compliance
Perform microtomy, IHC staining, and troubleshooting
Maintain records and keep spreadsheets updated
Escalate any non-conforming products to management, participate in the investigation process
Meet productivity standards and strive to increase productivity without sacrificing quality and safety
Look for ways to improve and promote quality
Demonstrate accuracy and thoroughness
Manage time and priorities to meet deadlines
The Production Lab Technician will troubleshoot equipment problems
Work on various projects to improve efficiency or compliance
Follow regulatory and standard requirements as applicable to the site, i.e., MDSAP, ISO 13485, IVDR, and compliance with the site Quality Manual.
Other duties as assigned or required by the business
cond_0292.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
AA/AS in a biological science or biochemistry field with 1 year of production experience OR high school diploma/GED and 3 years lab experience in a related discipline which supports the performance of required tasks in a final production role
Good computer skills, including MS Office
Good organizational skills and attention to detail
Good verbal and written communication skills including the ability to create clear, concise, written reports and accurately complete batch records
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge of FDA QSRs and ISO 13485 or other related industry standards; experience with SAP or other ERP systems is strongly preferred
Previous experience in FDA-regulated biotechnology or pharmaceutical environment
Knowledge of [Product name masked]
